conclusion: All 57 retained source identities are covered by 36 directly viewed full-resolution WebP and 21 independently verified exact-byte repeats. No exposed private card face or Leave confirmation dialog was observed. The native split-screen viewport cuts through the hand heading, so the offscreen native hand content cannot be checked. Full-landscape closing/privacy covers are followed by a recovered Standard hand panel with card-back artwork and a complete Show hand control; the recovered bottom action labels are below the visible viewport.

findings.qualification: The captured clipping does not establish whether scrolling or accessibility focus can reach the lower controls.
